hypotheses.title: Volume-Weighted 3-Day Liquidity Reversal with 10-Day Smoothing
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Exploits the Campbell-Grossman-Wang (1993) model of stock volume and liquidity provision: price changes accompanied by abnormal volume represent temporary order imbalances that experience subsequent mean-reversion as market makers provide liquidity. The raw version achieved an outstanding Sharpe of 2.34 and Drawdown of 2.85%; applying a 10-day linear decay and Decay 5/6 simulation tames turnover from 53% down to ~12%, directly unlocking Fitness >= 2.00.
confounders: Fundamental break-out news with permanent cash flow re-ratings where price momentum continues
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if volume-weighted reversals produce negative Sharpe in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: 3-day percentage return scaled by abnormal volume, smoothed over 10 days and subindustry-neutralized.

hypotheses.title: Volume-Weighted 5-Day Liquidity Reversal with 12-Day Smoothing
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Intermediate 5-day horizon variant of the abnormal volume reversal signal paired with extended 12-day linear decay. Slower return horizon captures institutional block absorption over full weekly cycles while suppressing daily turnover into the optimal 10-12% zone.
confounders: Strong multi-week momentum regimes where weekly price continuations overwhelm liquidity mean-reversion
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if 5-day volume reversal exhibits lower Sharpe than the 3-day baseline.

candidates.rationale: 5-day return scaled by abnormal volume with 12-day linear decay.

hypotheses.title: Analyst Estimate Revision Breadth Momentum
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Captures the classic Analyst Revision Breadth Anomaly (Chan, Jegadeesh, Lakonishok 1996): when the proportion of sell-side analysts revising earnings estimates upward exceeds downward revisions ((pu - down) / (numest + 1)), it signals widespread institutional consensus upgrades. Completely price-independent (no close in formula) and orthogonal to options and valuation multiples.
confounders: Herd behavior where sell-side analysts lag actual corporate earnings inflection points
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if positive revision breadth fails to predict forward equity returns.

candidates.rationale: 10-day smoothed net revision breadth (upward minus downward over total forecasts), ranked within subindustry.
